text: {"score":3,"justification":"The core facts match the card: 20.7% vs 3.7%, 3 of 7 documented 99215s below billed (43%), 39% low-complexity share, 5 of 21 with no lab, and z of 3.06. The cited claims largely fit their sentences. The caution is appropriate (\"moderate signal that needs coder review\"). However, the summary has real weaknesses. The dollar figures ($1,068, CI $344-$1,791) do not appear on the card and cannot be verified. It also contains redundancy, and C0081673 is cited as a low-complexity example although its documentation supports high MDM, which is not flagged as counter-evidence. The 0% peer rate is stated without noting that the small n (7) limits the comparison.
